prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12: cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/proofs/test_installer_lives_in_recovery.py reds two teeth on akiendell. tooth_files_are_home asserts not (ROOT/'cairn/machines/installer').exists(), but that dir holds only an untracked __pycache__/ (git ls-files is empty there), so a stale cache reads as 'still exists'. tooth_install_runs_from_the_new_home execs bin/cmd/install directly (line 74), which Windows cannot exec as a shebang script (WinError 193).
